description: deviation.rs:567-569 — the IssuerDnContains normalization does: let lower = s.to_lowercase(); if *s != lower { *s = lower; }. This always allocates a new String for the lowercase form before comparing. The matching code at line 340-341 correctly uses make_ascii_lowercase() in-place (zero extra allocation). Fix: use s.make_ascii_lowercase() directly (or s.to_ascii_lowercase()), consistent with the comment on line 336 that says make_ascii_lowercase avoids a second heap allocation. The caveat already documented (non-ASCII not handled) still applies either way.
title: [rusty/pkix-lint] DeviationStore::add: to_lowercase allocates before compare-and-discard
